notes: Spring Stinks features Bruce the Bear (from the Mother Bruce series) who grumpily endures the sights, smells, and creatures of spring — especially a persistent skunk. The word 'stinky' is central to the book's humour and theme and should be included even though it is slightly abstract; it is picturable (e.g. stink lines symbol). Several vocabulary items (skunk, flower, bee, butterfly, mud, smell, nose, trail) already exist in activity_images or aac_extras and can be reused. 'Spring' as a season may not have a perfect Boardmaker symbol — a sun-with-flowers or sprouting plant image may be the best match. 'Outside' covers the setting of the story. 'Hide' captures Bruce's key reaction/behaviour. Recommend checking existing activity_images assets for skunk, flower, bee, butterfly, mud before sourcing new icons.
